_help: Act 7, Hassan's confession (act7.gd starts it at the start of Act 7 if he's in the party): with his trust >= 2 he confesses (hassan_revealed) and offers the lockdown (the museum action act7_museum/lockdown). With less trust he keeps his secret. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

silent.speaker: hassan
silent.line: This is my city, and it is frightened. I will help where I can. Ask me, if you need a scholar.

confess.speaker: hassan
confess.line: There is something I must tell you before the sky goes dark. The riders on the road, the men at the river, the attack at the ruins. I sent them. I am one of the Keepers of the Veil.

choices.label: Ask why
choices.line: Why? We could have died out there.

choices.label: Forgive him
choices.line: You were trying to stop exactly this. I understand.

why.speaker: hassan
why.line: To stop anyone reaching that door. I failed, and others paid for it. But you are trying to undo what was done, and I can help.

condemn.speaker: hassan
condemn.line: Yes. They did. I will carry them. But let me help you now, so that no one else does.

forgive.speaker: hassan
forgive.line: You are kinder than I deserve. Then let me be useful.

offer.speaker: hassan
offer.line: The Antiquities Service still listens to me. I can have every export of antiquities stopped: the ports, the railway, everything. Not for long. But the thieves would have only one road out, and we would know which.
